messages.content: 你能計算我進行的科學實驗中空氣在恆壓下的熱容量嗎？我有一個容積為2.5立方公尺的容器，並能保持溫度在300開氏度。我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗。我在所有這些實驗中都使用空氣。你能提供這三種不同條件下的熱容量嗎？

function.name: calc_heat_capacity
function.description: Calculate the heat capacity at constant pressure of air using its temperature and volume. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

temp.description: The temperature of the gas in Kelvin.

volume.description: The volume of the gas in m^3. This is a float type value.

gas.description: Type of gas, with air as default.

We need to calculate heat capacity at constant pressure of air given temperature and volume. But the function signature expects temp (Kelvin) and volume (m^3). Gas default is air. We need to call the function three times: first temp=300°C? Wait 300°C is 573.15 K. But the user says "溫度在300開氏度" which is ambiguous: "300開氏度" could mean 300°C or 300 K? They say "溫度在300開氏度" but then "更高的溫度350開氏度". They likely mean Celsius. So convert to Kelvin: 300°C = 573.15 K, 350°C = 623.15 K. Volume 2.5 m^3 for first two experiments, then 1.5 m^3 for third experiment at 350°C? Actually they said: "我將在更高的溫度350開氏度重複這個實驗，接下來在更低的容積1.5立方公尺下一樣重複這個實驗" So they have three conditions: (1) V=2.5 m^3, T=300°C; (2) V=2.5 m^3, T=350°C; (3) V=1.5 m^3, T=350°C. All use air.
